title: Closeout summary: S02T01 - Define evidence trust levels and attestation schemas
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Added the published boreal.evidence-attestation.v1 contract with explicit legacy, self-reported, Boreal-witnessed, and external-attested trust levels; producer/witness identity, timestamps, subject revision, environment, command/output hashes, external identity, validation, deterministic identity, and legacy derivation are now encoded.

Close reason: Evidence trust levels and attestation schemas are published, validated, backward-compatible, and tested without silently strengthening legacy evidence.
